description: This file defines the interface for the AOM (Alliance for Open Media) video decoder, including versioning, capabilities, stream info, configuration, and function prototypes for initializing, parsing, decoding, and handling frames.

methods.name: aom_codec_dec_init_ver
methods.description: Initializes a decoder context with specified interface, configuration, flags, and ABI version.

methods.name: aom_codec_peek_stream_info
methods.description: Performs high-level parsing of the bitstream to extract stream info without constructing a decoder.

methods.name: aom_codec_get_stream_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current stream being decoded.

methods.name: aom_codec_decode
methods.description: Processes a buffer of encoded data to produce decoded frames.

methods.name: aom_codec_register_put_frame_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback for notification when a decoded frame is available.

methods.name: aom_codec_register_put_slice_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback for notification when a decoded slice is available.

methods.name: aom_codec_set_frame_buffer_functions
methods.description: Sets external frame buffer management functions for the decoder.
